description_en: Queries the submission result of a certificate application
description_zh: 申请证书提交结果查询
name: GetTaskAttribute

parameters.help_en: Specifies the type of the asynchronous task. Set the value to ApplyCertificate to query the submission result of the ApplyCertificate asynchronous task. Default value: ApplyCertificate
parameters.help_zh: ApplyCertificate异步任务提交结果查询，默认入参ApplyCertificate
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This parameter specifies the task identifier returned by the ApplyCertificate asynchronous task. You can obtain the value from the TaskId field in the response after you call the ApplyCertificate operation
parameters.help_zh:
实例id。
此参数为 ApplyCertificate 异步任务返回的任务标识符（调用 ApplyCertificate 后从响应 TaskId 字段获取）
parameters.name: task_id

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskStatus.description_en:
The task result. Valid values:
success: The submission succeeded.
processing: The submission is in progress.
failed: The submission failed
TaskStatus.description_zh:
任务结果。
success 提交成功。
processing 提交中。
failed 提交失败
